response.justification: The candidate is a versatile full-stack/web engineer with genuine passion for geospatial projects (GISCollective, Green Map) and some low-level systems programming exposure via DLang, but he lacks current, substantial C++ or Rust experience — his only C++ work was a brief stint in 2014-2015 and a student project. The role requires deep modern C++/Rust expertise for building production routing pipelines, which is not reflected in his recent decade of work focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and web frameworks.
strengths: Long-standing personal passion project (GISCollective) directly in the geospatial/GIS domain
Demonstrated systems-level programming experience (async I/O, fibers, low-latency services) via DLang at Sociomantic
Broad technical range across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems shows adaptability
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ or Rust experience — core requirement for this role is largely unmet
No evidence of distributed systems design (fault tolerance, consistency, service discovery) at the required depth
No direct experience with navigation/routing systems or routing tile pipelines
